weight_formula: effective_lambda**(-2) divided by its mean over the fitting scales
rate_selection: native first argmax of summed observed-support penalized weighted fit score; no ideal labels
amplitude_penalty: dual only: ridge * (b1**2 + b2**2), summed over observed outcomes; fixed offset not penalized
support: union of the Reset records actually supplied to the fit; include zero frequencies at scales where a union member was not observed
projection: Euclidean simplex restricted to observed union, zero outside
scope: same settings at every saved case and physical error rate
selection_disclosure: Chosen after inspecting existing count-data hyperparameter comparisons, including ideal-reference TVD and gap; not preregistered or independently validated, and not proven optimal under this mixed-ridge rule

bootstrap_plan.centers: saved-parent point estimates, not bootstrap means or medians
bootstrap_plan.intervals: pointwise 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired metric differences; conditional on empirical parents and selected settings

legacy_results: Preserve separately with their own estimator, ridge, beta, budget and seed identities; do not relabel legacy intervals as this configuration
